requirements: TLS reachable from the VPN VPS
SNI must be accepted by the selected target
Do not silently use a target that failed validation
Keep serverNames consistent with the selected target certificate/SNI behavior
notes: REALITY targets are deployment properties, not client-selected arbitrary domains.
Cloudflare-backed targets are not part of the automatic pool because Xray warns that unauthenticated fallback forwarding to some CDN targets can be abused after scanning.
Always re-check candidates from the actual VPS before deployment because reachability and network locality differ by hosting provider and region.
